sources_used: gretabar.com official site and location pages
Instagram/Facebook social corroboration for Greta YVR/YEG, Laser Force, Jack Potts
Venue sites: montrealbowling.ca, laurentianlanes.com, kingpincambridge.com, magicmountain.ca, happykingdombrampton.ca, moosemcguires.ca, midnightarcade.ca, luv2play.com, jackpotts.net, jacklecoq.com

findings.name: Good Vibes YK
findings.evidence_quote: Protein Shake Bar with 2 arcade machines. Games listed: only Ms. Pac-Man/Galaga: 25th Anniversary (comment notes Pac-Man 40th Anniversary).
findings.note: Tiny protein-shake bar; ZIv documents exactly two classic cabinets, neither rhythm/music. No later evidence of music cabs. Confidence limited by 2021 last update.

findings.name: Greta Calgary
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: Guitar Hero Arcade (International). Comment: Player 1 side doesn't have a strap. Player 2 side, fret buttons are heavily worn and strumbar is tilted downwards. Updated 2024-11-17.
findings.note: Guitar Hero Arcade only music title. Not a valid named slug so mapped to other. Corroborated by arcade-museum.com and r/Calgary (Guitar Hero at Greta). Open per gretabar.com.

findings.name: Greta Edmonton
findings.evidence_quote: Page title: Greta Edmonton CLOSED. History: Location marked as closed. (nico2_ni, ~2026-08-03). Official gretabar.com locations list only Calgary, Vancouver, Toronto; Edmonton omitted.
findings.note: Formerly had Guitar Hero Arcade while open. Permanently closed; not on current Greta chain location list.

findings.name: Greta Toronto
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: Guitar Hero Arcade (International). Updated 2025-09-20. Yelp: pinball games... and guitar hero play-off's.
findings.note: Guitar Hero Arcade mapped to other. Venue open on gretabar.com Toronto page.

findings.name: Greta Vancouver
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: Guitar Hero Arcade (International). Location: Across from the food bar, between the Joust and Big Buck Hunter machines. Recent social (CanucksArmy/Instagram) still references Guitar Hero at GRETA Bar YVR.
findings.note: ZIv last full list 2023 but 2025-2026 social still promotes Guitar Hero at YVR. Mapped to other. Open per gretabar.com.

findings.name: Gros Fun (Les Promenades Gatineau)
findings.evidence_quote: ZIv cab notes (shard): Angry Birds Boom!; Halo Fireteam Raven; Hockey Table; Jurassic Park Arcade; Lane Master; Minecraft Dungeons Arcade; emoji Mini Hoops. Mall promo: Jeux d'arcade + aire de jeux. No music/rhythm titles named.
findings.note: Family FEC/redemption. No rhythm games in known list, but absence of evidence is not confirmed_none. Still open per Promenades Gatineau promo (~2026).

findings.name: Gros Fun Laurier
findings.evidence_quote: ZIv notes: Cruis'n Blast; Epic Shooter; Hockey Table; Jurassic Park Arcade; MotoGP Arcade. Reddit Quebec City arcade tour mentions Gros Fun Laurier as family arcade; no rhythm games cited.
findings.note: Place Laurier family arcade. No music cabs documented; not enough positive evidence for confirmed_none.

findings.name: Happy Kingdom Brampton
findings.evidence_quote: Indoor playground and arcade branding. ZIv notes list redemption/sport cabs only (Bigfoot Crush, Jurassic Park Arcade, NERF, Super Bikes 3, claws/ticket games). No rhythm titles found.
findings.note: Open (Instagram active). FEC-style floor; no music-game evidence either way.

findings.name: Heather Lanes Bowling Centre
findings.evidence_quote: ZIv notes: Claw Machine; Final Lap 3; Stacker. Bowling centre in New Glasgow NS.
findings.note: Sparse cab list, all non-music. No positive confirmation that no rhythm games exist or that venue is closed. Leave unknown.

findings.name: Highland Square Mall
findings.evidence_quote: ZIv notes: Claw Machine; Hurricane Simulator. Mall location New Glasgow NS. No music games listed.
findings.note: Minimal ZIv data; no independent corroboration of current floor. Unknown.

findings.name: Holy Bowly
findings.evidence_quote: Pinball Map: 12-lane candlepin bowling alley with a bar, hamburger stand, and some retro arcade games and pinball. ZIv notes long retro list (Contra, Pac-Man, Street Fighter II, etc.) with no music/rhythm titles.
findings.note: Still operating (2026 social). Retro barcade feel but no documented ITG/DDR/Guitar Hero. Unknown rather than confirmed_none.

findings.name: House Of Targ
findings.evidence_quote: Official games list includes GuiTARG Hero among classic arcade games. Northly (2026-05-30): vintage classics like Galaga, Tetris, Space Invaders and Guitar Hero.
findings.note: Official site lists GuiTARG Hero (console/cab Guitar Hero setup). ZIv visitor comment claimed no music games (2022) but site/list overrides for presence. Not standard Guitar Hero Arcade dedicab; mapped to other. No groove_coaster on official list despite one Instagram mention elsewhere.

findings.name: Hwy 404 & Steeles Flea Market
findings.evidence_quote: ZIv notes: Boxer; Bust A Move (MVS); Initial D Arcade Stage Version.3; Marvel vs. Capcom 2; Metal Slug 5; Ms. Pac-Man; San Francisco Rush; Tekken 5; Virtua Fighter 4 Evolution. Weekend flea-market hours only.
findings.note: Fighting/racing/classic cabs only on ZIv. No rhythm evidence. Flea market stalls can change; leave unknown.

findings.name: Jack Potts Thrill Zone
findings.evidence_quote: Comment (HrdrThnLemnade, ~2024-10): Got rid of their DDR machine a year or two ago. Games section: No games at this location. Info historically mentioned DDR on One Token Tuesdays.
findings.note: Positive evidence that the only known music game (DDR) was removed. Still open as redemption arcade (jackpotts.net, Instagram). No other rhythm titles reported.

findings.name: Jack le Coq
findings.evidence_quote: Actually a fast food restaurant, but it does have two arcade cabinets. IMPORTANT: The games however change very frequently and are very unlikely to be the ones listed. Listed: Mortal Kombat; Console in a Cab (Streets of Rage 3). Updated 2026-07-08.
findings.note: Fried-chicken chain location with exactly two rotating free-play non-music cabs. Not a music venue. confirmed_none for rhythm games.

findings.name: Karting Orford
findings.evidence_quote: Official arcade page: En parlant de mains, si vous avez celles d'un Guitar Hero, vous pouvez tester votre dextérité en vous efforçant de suivre le rythme rock imposé... ZIv also lists In the Groove 2 dedicab (OpenITG/ITG3 theme) as of 2023-06-21.
findings.note: Guitar Hero confirmed on venue website. ITG2 on ZIv 2023 but not mentioned on current official page; do not treat ITG as certain. Both map to other if present.

findings.name: Kids Kingdom Orléans
findings.evidence_quote: ZIv notes: Aliens Armageddon; Angry Birds Arcade; Basketball Machine; Flappy Bird; Jurassic Park Arcade; MotoGP Arcade. Indoor playground site kidskingdom.ca.
findings.note: Kids FEC/redemption. No rhythm titles found. Not positive enough for confirmed_none.

findings.name: King Pin Bowling
findings.evidence_quote: ZIv notes: Claw Machine; Cruis'n World; Deal or No Deal; Extreme Hunting; Hockey Table; Popcorn; Stacker. Amherst NS bowling.
findings.note: No music games in sparse list. Status and full floor not independently verified.

findings.name: Kingpin Cambridge
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: In the Groove 2 (North America). Location: Turn right when you enter, located across from the indoor jungle gym. Comment: Player 1 unplayable, Player 2 OK, version r21 with USB support, running ITG3 theme. Updated 2023-01-23.
findings.note: ITG2 dedicab only music title. ZIv last update 2023; no newer confirmation found. Mapped to other. Venue still exists as bowling/laser (kingpincambridge.com).

findings.name: Landmark Cinemas City Centre
findings.evidence_quote: ZIv notes: Cabs: Batman. Cinema lobby arcade Edmonton City Centre.
findings.note: Minimal ZIv data. No rhythm evidence.

findings.name: Landmark Cinemas Kingston
findings.evidence_quote: ZIv notes: Extreme Shot; Hot Flash; Ice Ball; Key Master; Super Cars; Terminator Salvation; Time Crisis 4. Cinema redemption/shooter floor.
findings.note: No music games listed. Unknown.

findings.name: Laser City Laser Tag
findings.evidence_quote: ZIv notes: Aliens: Extermination; OutRun 2 SP; Star Wars Battle Pod; Terminator Salvation; Time Crisis 4. Laser tag + arcade Calgary Aero Drive.
findings.note: Shooters/racers only in ZIv notes. No rhythm evidence.

findings.name: Laser City South Calgary
findings.evidence_quote: ZIv notes: Aliens Armageddon; H2Overdrive. Small cab list.
findings.note: No music games documented.

findings.name: Laser Force Drummondville
findings.evidence_quote: Official: Nos plus populaires... sans oublier Guitar Hero, Pac-Man, Need for Speed. NOS MACHINES lists Guitar Hero: Devenez rockstar le temps d'une chanson. FAQ: 14 machines: Guitar Hero, Pac-Man... ZIv also historically listed In the Groove 2 (2023); ITG not on current official 14-machine list.
findings.note: Guitar Hero confirmed current on operator site (maps to other). ITG2 was on ZIv 2023 and insert-coin listing but absent from official machine list and Canada-thread notes about ITG removals; do not claim ITG without fresh evidence.

findings.name: Lasermaxx Ottawa
findings.evidence_quote: ZIv notes: Hot Wheels: King Of The Road; Multicade; NBA Superstars; Super Cars; Tomb Raider Arcade. Operator promotes laser tag + arcade; no rhythm titles named in available sources.
findings.note: Arcade present but no music-game evidence.

findings.name: Laurentian Lanes
findings.evidence_quote: Major Montreal bowling centre (66 lanes). ZIv entry has null game notes. Site focuses on bowling; no public music-cab inventory found.
findings.note: Open (2026 website/Facebook). Arcade presence unclear; no rhythm evidence.

findings.name: Level Up Arcade (Landmark Cinemas Country Hills)
findings.evidence_quote: ZIv notes: Centipede Chaos; Cruis'n Blast; Doodle Jump Arcade; Fantastic Prize; Fire Storm; Grand Piano Keys; Lane Master XTREME; Monster Drop X-TREME; Quik Drop; Sports Blaster; Ticket Monster.
findings.note: Cinema Level Up redemption floor. No rhythm titles.

findings.name: Level Up Arcade (Landmark Cinemas Kanata)
findings.evidence_quote: ZIv notes: Air FX; Boxer; Extreme Shot; Fantastic Prize; Fast & Furious Arcade (2022); Jurassic Park Arcade; Lane Master; Taj Mahal Mini; Terminator Salvation.
findings.note: No music games in ZIv list.

findings.name: Level Up Arcade (Landmark Cinemas Orléans)
findings.evidence_quote: ZIv notes: Extreme Shot; Key Master; NERF: Arcade; Stacker.
findings.note: Small redemption set. No rhythm evidence.

findings.name: Luv2Play
findings.evidence_quote: ZIv notes: Jurassic Park Arcade (2015); Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (2018). Grande Prairie FEC.
findings.note: Incomplete ZIv list likely; no rhythm titles found online.

findings.name: Magic Mountain TekZone
findings.evidence_quote: Magic Mountain Moncton TekZone: digital arcade action and redemption. ZIv notes long list of shooters/racing/redemption (After Burner, Cruis'n USA, Jurassic Park Arcade, Super Bikes 2, etc.) with no music titles.
findings.note: Seasonal park attraction still promoted. No rhythm evidence.

findings.name: Merivale Bowling Centre
findings.evidence_quote: ZIv notes: Big Bass Wheel Pro; Cruis'n Blast; Down The Clown; Extreme Hoops; Fantastic Prize; Halo Fireteam Raven; Ice Ball; Pirates Hook; Sink It; Spin N Win; Stacker; Tower of Tickets; Wheel of Fortune.
findings.note: Bowling + redemption. No music games in documented list.

findings.name: Midnight Arcade
findings.evidence_quote: ZIv notes: Basketball Machine; Bust A Move (MVS); Initial D Arcade Stage 4; Street Fighter II; Time Crisis; Viewpoint. Freeplay arcade bar 158 Augusta Ave still active on Instagram.
findings.note: ZIv music-empty. Some third-party Guitar Hero snippets appear to refer to Greta YYZ not Midnight; do not attach. No verified rhythm cab for this sid.

findings.name: Mille Pattes Amusements
findings.evidence_quote: Indoor playground Lévis. ZIv notes: Hydro Thunder; Manx TT Superbike; Mario Kart Arcade GP; San Francisco Rush 2049; Sega Super GT; Typhoon.
findings.note: Racing/simulators only on ZIv. No rhythm evidence.

findings.name: MontVR Trois-Rivières
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: Guitar Hero Arcade (International). Full cab list also includes many redemption/racing titles. Entry created/updated 2025-08-01 by Automaton.
findings.note: Guitar Hero Arcade mapped to other. 2025 ZIv survey; no contrary source.

findings.name: Montréal Bowling
findings.evidence_quote: Site: 16 allées de bowling, des arcades et des tables de billard. ZIv notes: Boxing Champion; Golden Tee 2020; PAC-MAN Basket; Pool Table; Stinger; Super Bikes 2; Super Cars; Super Chexx; Terminator Salvation; World's Largest Pac-Man. Shard hours_text said Mon-Sun closed but venue reopened March 2024 (The Main) and is operating 2026.
findings.note: Open again after multi-year closure. No rhythm titles in ZIv list or marketing. Not confirmed_none.

findings.name: Moonlight Movies
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: In the Groove 2 (North America). Location: First machine to the right as you enter the Games room. Comment: Sometimes set to free play, but $2 for three songs. Has a bunch of customs loaded, and it's on a H4X Edition retheme. Updated 2026-06-13 by impurpl3.
findings.note: Very recent ZIv confirmation of ITG2 at Golden Mile / Moonlight Movies Cinemas Regina. Mapped to other (ITG not a named slug).

findings.name: Moose McGuire's Orleans
findings.evidence_quote: There's a Guitar Hero arcade cabinet commanding attention near the entrance, and not one but four pinball machines: Godzilla, Avengers, Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles, and Jaws.
findings.note: Independent review documents Guitar Hero Arcade cabinet. ZIv page only lists TRON Legacy pinball and Golden Tee (outdated vs review). Mapped to other.

findings.name: Moose McGuire’s Kanata
findings.evidence_quote: ZIv notes: Monster Bash; PGA TOUR GOLF: TEAM CHALLENGE; The Sopranos. Pub with limited arcade/pinball; no music titles found for Kanata location (unlike Orleans).
findings.note: Do not copy Orleans Guitar Hero to Kanata. Separate venue; unknown for rhythm.
